snippet.title: 👑 DrunKing - Oficial Trailer 🍺
snippet.description:
A game where you control a poor old drunk man who’s been dethroned from his booze-soaked kingdom!
Now, it’s time to prove he’s still got what it takes to be the true King of the Party!

🕒 Survive the clock!
🍻 Drink to earn points!
💥 Use crazy powers!
👕 Customize your drunk with funny clothes and mustaches!
🏆 Unlock achievements and discover mysterious relics!
😵‍💫 But be careful... the more you drink, the drunker you get!

🤪 The effects are totally insane, and the fun never ends!

🎮 Play the DEMO now on Steam
💖 Add it to your Wishlist
💸 Support the development on Catarse

👇 Official links:
🔗 Steam: DrunKing
🔗 Catarse: Game DrunKing
🔗 Follow the development: DrunKingBR

🍺 DrunKing – The game that proves being king is all about balance!
